The Complaints Handling Policy is governed by the requirements of the Financial Conduct Authority.
The policy defines reporting structures to identify and address systemic complaint issues.
The policy contains the requirement for monthly reporting to management.
The policy contains the requirement for quarterly reporting to the Board.
The policy contains the requirement for annual reporting to the FCA.
Monthly reporting obligations are directed to and reviewed by Management.
Monthly reporting is executed through the Complaints Reporting and Analytics control measure.
context: Monthly Report to Management: Total complaints received, Average resolution time...

description: Quarterly reporting obligations are directed to and reviewed by the Board.
Quarterly board reporting is executed through the Complaints Reporting and Analytics control measure.
context: Quarterly Report to Board: Complaint volume trends, Top complaint types...

description: Quarterly board reporting is specifically designed to identify systemic issues.
The annual report fulfills the regulatory reporting requirements of the FCA.
Annual FCA reporting is executed through the Complaints Reporting and Analytics control measure.
context: Annual Report to FCA: Aggregate statistics, Complaint handling effectiveness...

description: Systemic complaint issues are identified and mitigated through the Reporting and Analytics control.
Management performs and reviews the monthly analytics reporting.
The Board reviews the quarterly results of the analytics and reporting control.
